title: Darts Game with Dynamic Difficulty
prompt:
Create a fully interactive 3D darts game using Three.js with dynamic difficulty scaling. The game uses a damaged helmet model as a decorative trophy that appears when the player achieves high scores.

## Scene Setup
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 1.6, 3) looking toward the dartboard at (0, 1.6, -3).
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a spotlight (intensity 1.2) pointing at the dartboard from (0, 3, 0).
- Create a circular dartboard at z=-3, centered at (0, 1.6, -3), radius 0.5, facing the camera.
- The dartboard has concentric scoring rings: Bullseye (radius < 0.025, 50 pts), Inner Bull (0.025-0.06, 25 pts), Triple Ring (0.19-0.21, triple of sector score), Inner Single (0.06-0.19, sector score), Outer Single (0.21-0.32, sector score), Double Ring (0.32-0.34, double of sector score), Outside (>0.34, 0 pts).
- Sector base scores follow standard darts: 20 sectors of values [20,1,18,4,13,6,10,15,2,17,3,19,7,16,8,11,14,9,12,5] going clockwise from top.
- Load the model 'DamagedHelmet.glb' using GLTFLoader. Place it at (2, 0.5, -2), scale 0.3. It should be invisible initially and only appear (visible=true) when the player's cumulative score reaches 100 or more. It should slowly rotate on its Y-axis.

## Dart Mechanics
- Create dart objects as small elongated cones (height 0.15, radius 0.015) colored red.
- The player aims by moving the mouse. Display a small crosshair (a '+' shaped DOM element or 3D object) that follows mouse position projected onto the dartboard plane.
- Clicking the left mouse button throws a dart. The dart should animate from camera position to the aimed point on the dartboard over 0.4 seconds with a slight parabolic arc.
- After the dart lands, compute the score based on where it hit the dartboard.

## Dynamic Difficulty
- Start at difficulty level 1. Track difficulty in state.
- At difficulty 1: no random offset is applied to dart throws (perfect accuracy).
- At difficulty 2 (after cumulative score >= 50): add random offset up to 0.03 units to the dart landing position.
- At difficulty 3 (after cumulative score >= 150): add random offset up to 0.06 units AND the dartboard slowly rotates (0.2 rad/s around Z-axis).
- Display the current difficulty level in a HUD element with id='difficulty-display'.

## Game State & HUD
- The player has 3 darts per round, 3 rounds total (9 darts max).
- Display: current round (id='round-display'), darts remaining in round (id='darts-display'), current round score (id='round-score-display'), total cumulative score (id='total-score-display'), last dart score (id='last-dart-score').
- Add a 'New Game' button (id='new-game-btn') that resets everything.
- After all 9 darts are thrown, display 'Game Over' in a div with id='game-over-msg'.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- totalScore: number (cumulative score across all rounds)
- roundScore: number (current round score)
- currentRound: number (1-3)
- dartsRemaining: number (3,2,1,0 within a round)
- dartsThrown: number (total darts thrown 0-9)
- difficultyLevel: number (1, 2, or 3)
- lastDartScore: number (score of the most recent dart)
- lastDartPosition: {x: number, y: number} (position on dartboard plane relative to center)
- gameOver: boolean
- helmetVisible: boolean
- boardRotation: number (current Z rotation of dartboard in radians)
- dartInFlight: boolean (true while dart is animating)

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame and after every interaction.
physics_constraints: Dart trajectory follows a slight parabolic arc from camera to board. Landing position accuracy degrades with difficulty level. Dartboard rotation at difficulty 3 must be continuous and smooth. Score calculations must be mathematically precise based on radial distance and angular sector.
